name: LethAL Sandbox Names Tests
brief: LethAL R557 fixture: one test per procedure of the names target, under names al-runner renames.
description: One test per procedure of fixtures/sandbox-names. Ten AL names are renamed by al-runner's C# identifier rule (space, -, (), ., /, &, a leading digit, the keyword Default, Danish letters) and two are unrenamed controls. Asserts via Error(), no Library Assert. Not for production use, see fixtures/README.md.
